title: Amtrak separates 302 completed and 126 active station designs
summary: Amtrak reports 302 station designs completed and 126 design projects in progress in the June 2026 program inventory. Denominator: The report's 428 design-status entries, kept separate from construction, turnover, final completion, operating availability, and passenger use.
